name: ship-tasks
description: Deliver selected Task Manager work and explain technical outcomes in clear user language.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver work and explain outcomes clearly.
interface.longDescription: Includes two sibling skills. Ship Tasks delivers work through explicit $ship-tasks or natural language that names an existing Task or selected Task Manager scope. A delivery verb alone does not activate it. Every Ship Tasks completion, rework, or blocker report uses Strategic Explainer for the human-facing narrative while Ship Tasks retains status and evidence authority.
defaultPrompt: Deliver TM-123 to a verified terminal outcome
Create exactly one Task in Task Manager and immediately start delivering it
Use Strategic Explainer to clarify this technical result
